title: SkillMutator: Benchmarking and Defending Language-and-Code Cross-modal Attacks on LLM Agent Skills
description: Artifact for the ACSAC 2026 paper "SkillMutator: Benchmarking and Defending Language-and-Code Cross-modal Attacks on LLM Agent Skills." The bundle reproduces the 12 claimed tables/figures (Tables 3-8, 10, 11, Figures 4-6) from bundled scanner-verdict data via per-claim run.sh scripts that check recomputed metrics against machine-readable golden values, and it ships the end-to-end code (SkillMutator mutation pipeline and the fine-tuning framework): the live tiers regenerate the mutation-side floats and demonstrate the fine-tuning process. Tier 1 claim verification runs on public research infrastructure (any CPU, no GPU, no API key); the full live tier additionally needs an NVIDIA A100 80 GB and an OpenAI API key. Adversarial (mutated) Agent Skills are NOT bundled, to prevent misuse; they are generated on disk only when the live pipeline (Tier 2-4) is run and must be used only as scanner inputs in an isolated environment. The bundle contains scanner verdicts and aggregates only; raw scanner text and full mutations are withheld.
